payload.title: Residual-model consensus abstention
payload.statement: Disagreement and sign consensus across independently trained surface-free datum models can identify when E008-like signed residual action is transferable, allowing exact abstention to E006 in unstable regimes without using hidden outcomes at inference.
payload.evidence_for: E008 datum action has meaningful pooled and tail gain, E007 features add measurable value, and performance varies sharply across immutable fold models and shift groups. This creates target-independent ensemble disagreement that is available at inference.
payload.evidence_against: Prior risk and visible pseudo-gain signals did not reliably authorize signed action. Model consensus may merely reflect shared bias, and any observed E008 subgroup threshold is ineligible for reuse.
payload.next_test: E009: pre-register a datum-only multi-model ensemble and nested consensus/abstention rule before scoring. Train every model inside legal folds, derive uncertainty only from prediction dispersion/sign agreement, use exact E006 fallback, and require all repeated, tail, spatial/typewell, shuffle, runtime, final-placement, packaging, and parity gates.
